description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.
 
 This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing.  By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.
 
 This Position reports to:
Application Engineering Manager - Industries Robotics 
 
 The Robotics Application Engineer will partner with our sales teams in the West (Regions: Northern California, Pacific Northwest and South California) you will work on supporting our advanced interfaces for machine centric robotic applications, and work on proof-of-concepts, cycle time evaluations, reach studies, and configure robotic solutions for PC centric robotic applications.

 This role will be remote and have up to 35% of travel in the region listed.  Ideal candidate would be based in Northern California/Seattle or Oregon market near a major metro airport. 
 


 Core Responsibilities 
 Work with sales to review customer requirements, propose and design robotic solutions.
 Showcase proof of concept and other demonstrations and presentations to customers.
 Develop server applications that drive the robots, AI modeling, and strong understanding of automation engineering and mechatronics. 
 Ensure all solutions comply with customer specs and any code requirements.
 Collaborate with customers, internal teams and potentially third party to address any issues, handle any changes in proposal or other documentation and alignment on requirements.
 


 Requirements 

 Bachelor’s in engineering or computer science with 5+ years in developing client/server applications.
 Must be competent on Java script, REST, Linux, and Python. 
 Must be competent on AI modeling (data sets, labeling, training)
 Comfortable presenting and interacting with all levels of customers as well as peer teams (sales, project management, etc.)
 Mechatronic engineering knowledge is desirable
 Automation engineering knowledge is desirable.
 Travel: 35% travel is required for this position. 
 

 What's in it for you 

 We empower you to take the lead, share bold ideas, and shape real outcomes. You’ll grow through hands-on experience, mentorship, and learning that fits your goals. Here, your work doesn’t just matter, it moves things forward

 ABB is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer for protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities at ABB.

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their- sex (gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation), marital status, citizenship, age,  race and ethnicity, inclusive of traits historically associated with race or ethnicity, including but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles, color, religious creed, national origin, pregnancy, physical or mental disability, genetic information, protected Veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal and state law.

 For more information regarding your (EEO) rights as an applicant, please visit the following websites: https://www.eeoc.gov/sites/default/files/2023-06/22-088_EEOC_KnowYourRights6.12ScreenRdr.pdf 

 As an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer for Protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities, applicants may request to review the plan of a particular ABB facility between the hours of 9:00 A.M. - 5:00 P.M. EST Monday through Friday by contacting an ABB HR Representative at 1-888-694-7762. 

 Protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access ABB's career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by calling an ABB HR Representative at 1-888-694-7762 or by sending an email to US-AskHR@abb.com . Resumes and applications will not be accepted in this manner. 

 ABB Benefit Summary for eligible US employees 
 [excludes ABB E-mobility, Athens union, Puerto Rico]
 Go to MyBenefitsABB.com and click on “Candidate/Guest” to learn more

 Health, Life & Disability 
 Choice between two medical plan options: A PPO plan called the Copay Plan OR a High Deductible Health Plan (with a Health Savings Account) called the High Deductible Plan. 
 Choice between two dental plan options: Core and Core Plus
 Vision benefit
 Company paid life insurance (2X base pay)
 Company paid AD&D (1X base pay)
 Voluntary life and AD&D – 100% employee paid up to maximums
 Short Term Disability – up to 26 weeks – Company paid
 Long Term Disability – 60% of pay – Company paid.  Ability to “buy-up” to 66 2/3% of pay.
 Supplemental benefits – 100% employee paid (Accident insurance, hospital indemnity, critical illness, pet insurance
 Parental Leave – up to 6 weeks
 Employee Assistance Program
 Health Advocate support resources for mental/behavioral health, general health navigation and virtual health, and infertility/adoption
 Employee discount program
 
 Retirement 
 401k Savings Plan with Company Contributions 
 Employee Stock Acquisition Plan (ESAP)
 
 Time off 
 ABB provides 11 paid holidays.  Vacation is provided based on years of service for hourly and non-exempt positions.  Salaried exempt positions are provided vacation under a permissive time away policy.

 
 We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
